
# PureGym Apple Wallet

> A free, iPhone-only method of adding a PureGym membership QR code to Apple Wallet using two Apple Shortcuts and WalletWallet. No computer, Mac, paid app or manually generated QR code is required.

## Project

Repository: https://github.com/newmanfr/PureGym-Apple-Wallet

This project allows PureGym members to add their membership QR code to Apple Wallet and automatically refresh the pass using Apple's Shortcuts app.

## Features

- Add a PureGym membership pass to Apple Wallet.
- Uses two downloadable Apple Shortcuts.
- Automatically retrieves and refreshes the PureGym QR code.
- Daily automatic refresh through Shortcuts automation.
- Runs directly on an iPhone.
- No PC, Mac or separate automation application required.
- Uses WalletWallet to generate and update the Wallet pass.
- Free setup, subject to WalletWallet's current free-tier limits.

## Installation

Read the complete installation guide:

https://github.com/newmanfr/PureGym-Apple-Wallet

## Apple Shortcuts

Generate PureGym:
https://www.icloud.com/shortcuts/8c6c3c72e21b4379abdf44127b9a86c0

Start:
https://www.icloud.com/shortcuts/dde2a221d74e4205a3da90595d94522f

## Requirements

- iPhone with Apple's Shortcuts app.
- PureGym membership and login credentials.
- WalletWallet account and API key.
- Apple Wallet.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I add PureGym to Apple Wallet?
Yes. This project creates a PureGym membership pass in Apple Wallet.

### Does it work without a computer?
Yes. Setup and normal operation can be completed on an iPhone.

### Does the QR code update automatically?
Yes. A daily Shortcuts automation refreshes the Wallet pass.

### Is it free?
The project is free to set up, subject to WalletWallet's current free-tier limits.

### Do I need Scriptable?
No.

### Do I need a Mac?
No.

### Do I need to jailbreak my iPhone?
No.

### Is this an official PureGym application?
No. This is an independent community project and is not affiliated with PureGym.
